spans.text: Good afternoon. It is currently 1230 Frankfurt time on November 15th. Welcome to the news.
The major illegal arms trafficking case involving weapons known as "Iaso's Boxes" has officially concluded. The scope of the case spans across multiple cities, including Berlin and Frankfurt.
Authorities have confirmed the mastermind behind the operation to be Carter Petrovich Neustadt, a former member of the Neo-Soviet Army General Staff and Chief of Staff of an army group.

The organization behind him operated under multiple false identities, establishing factories within our borders to illegally manufacture weapons and colluding with certain customs officials to smuggle them out.
This group had allegedly been planning to use the weapons to launch an armed coup against Moscow.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs has urgently contacted the Neo-Soviet authorities and reached a consensus—any conspiracy that threatens peace must be crushed.
Relevant departments have already begun the investigation and shutdown of these illegal weapons factories, and all confiscated weapons will be destroyed.
Meanwhile, an internal investigation into the customs officials involved has been initiated by the police.
Yesterday, the Public Prosecutor's Office placed Carter Neustadt on Interpol's wanted list and issued a Red Notice for his arrest.
We also call on the public to actively provide any leads to local law enforcement. Submissions can be sent to the following email address...
The shrill and abrupt sound of a defense alarm pierces the quiet night of Frankfurt.
...We interrupt this broadcast to declare a national state of emergency.
In accordance with government directives, we are now transmitting through the Emergency Alert System.
Three mechanical alarm tones echo with a growing sense of foreboding.
This is an emergency action notification.
All broadcasting stations and cable systems must now transmit this emergency action notification.
This is UFG Broadcasting. We will continue to serve the Frankfurt area. If you are not in this region, please tune in to your local news and emergency broadcast provider.
You are now listening to the Frankfurt regional Emergency Alert System.
Do not use your communicators unless necessary. Please keep your communication channels open for emergency use.
A man repeats the message.
After a brief pause, a woman continues the broadcast.
Good evening. By the authority of General Secretary Groß, Supreme Leader of the German Democratic Republic, I have been granted permission to deliver the following statement.
Due to an unidentified enemy airstrike, the entire city of Frankfurt is now under a state of high alert. The air raid sirens have been activated.
All citizens hearing this broadcast or the sirens must immediately seek shelter in the nearest underground air defense bunker, civil defense structure, or bomb shelter.
A piercing, prolonged air raid siren howls above Frankfurt. Then, suddenly—
BOOM!
Countless explosions erupt, heralding the beginning of a catastrophe.
[Isolation Forest - END]
